༄༅// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pa'i rtogs brjod las 'phros pa'i bstod pa ut+pa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ rgyal ba'i dgongs don smra ba'i shing rta cher// grags pa'i rol mo phyogs bral rna ba'i dpyid// 'jigs bral bi rū pa yi sku'i che ba// cung zad gleng ba'i rgyud mangs 'khrol bar bgyi// mngon mtho'i rgyal srid spangs nas nā len+dār// gzhi kun yod smra'i sde las rab tu byung*// gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mthar son mkhas pa'i mchog /mkhan po dpal ldan chos skyong grags la 'dud// bshad sgrub bgyi bas nyin mtshan dus 'da' tshe// bsgrubs pa'i dngos grub 'gyang bar bdag med mas// dbugs dbyung dbang bskur snyan brgyud bzhi'i gdams pas// sa drug yon tan mngon du mdzad la 'dud// ye shes ma tshogs tha mal gzugs 'khrul pa'i// skye bos chos la smod pa spang phyir rang*// rab byung rtags spangs ngan par khas blangs nas// grong bzhud brtul zhugs spyod pa skyong la 'dud// gaṅgā'i chus kyang bka' las 'da' ma nus// bde ba'i lam byin 'khor mo 'jig tu byon// rgyal ngan chad pas lan mang chur bskyur yang*// slar byon ngo mtshar chos su bkod la 'dud// rgya gar lho phyogs gzhan don bgrod lam du// sdigs mdzub bstan pas gaṅgā gyen bzlog tshe// 'gram ngogs skye bos gsol btab gzhol phyogs btang*// ko mkhan rjes 'brangs byin gyis brlabs la 'dud// chang 'tshong grong gshegs nyi ma gteng par gzung*// yul khams bco brgyad chang ni zad bzhes pas// nyin mtshan dus tshod 'khrugs tshe myos byed rin// mi bdag gis byin nyi ma btang la 'dud// dbyangs can mgrin chags gtam gyis mu stegs bdag /rab tu dga' bas mchod gnas mchog bkur tshe// dbang phyug mtshan mar phyag mchod ring spangs te// rgyal yum mchod pa'i sprin gyis gtibs la 'dud// dman pa'i rten la dbang med phyag byas pas// tshal bar bkas tshe kun gyis gsol btab ngor// spyi bor 'phags mchog sku yi rgyas btab nas// su zhig mchod pa'i legs byas spel la 'dud// des bskyed gtam gyis gang du gshegs pa'i lam// mu stegs lha rten ji snyed gzhig dogs nas// spyi bor de bzhin gshegs pas brgyan cing mchod// mthong thos legs pa'i lam du sbyar la 'dud// ma he brgya stong mchod sbyin dbang phyug rten// rkang pas bsnun 'phral bran bzhin rjes 'khrid tshe// kun gyis gsol btab sdig bral mchod pa yis// tshim par dam bcas rnal du bkod la 'dud// tri shū las bkum mi shas tsaṇ+ḍi kā// mchod pa'i drung gshegs rtse gsum phyer btags nas// gtum mo'i gzugs bcom mchod rten zhabs su mnan// rnal 'byor ma tshogs skyabs su btud la 'dud// ḍom+bi shar phyogs rgyal po gdul phyir btang*// rang nyid kha sar+pā ṇi'i drung gshegs nas// legs byas rtogs pa phul tshe 'phags pas kyang*// mthu stobs mchog gi rdo rjer bsngags la 'dud// dkon mchog mchod mthar nub phyogs sau rāṣ+ṭar// srog chags du ma bkums pa'i srog bsrung phyir// gshegs pa'i lam du dbang phyug bram zer brdzus// co 'drir ma bzlog rang gzugs btud la 'dud// dbang phyug sha khrag mchod pa ring spangs nas// dkon mchog mchod pa'i lhag ma sdig bral gyis// bskal pa'i srid du tshim pa'i dam bca' phul// kun gyi mnyes gshin dam par gyur la 'dud// gcer bu rjes 'brang slob dpon nag po par// byin rlabs shar phyogs 'gro ba'i don brdzangs nas// rang nyid so ba nā thar gser 'gyur rtsi'i// 'byung gnas bskal pa'i bar du bzhugs la 'dud// rgya gar yul dbus glang chen smyon pa yis// nyer 'tshe byung ba gdul phyir gshegs pa dang*// dpal ldan sa skyar bla chen snying po la// bgrang yas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor la 'dud// stobs kyi mgon po'i rtogs brjod chu'i gter las// rlabs kyi zegs ma 'dra ba gleng ba'i mthus// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i phung po khyod bzhin du// mi mthun phyogs las rgyal bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa bi rū pa'i rtogs brjod las 'phros pa'i bstod pa ut+pa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di'ang 'di'i rnam thar ri mor 'god pa'i tshe ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa maṅga laṃ//

// ༄༅// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pa'i srung ba thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs// ༄༅// rdo rje 'chang dang grub chen bi rū pa// kun dga' snying po rtse mo grags rgyal mtshan// sa skya paṇa chen tshogs sgom nyan chen par// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// brag phug pa dang bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs// dpal ldan tshul khrims grub chen bud+dha shrī// ngor chen kun dga' bzang po sems dpa' cher// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel// lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs// sangs rgyas seng ge nam mkha' dpal bzang la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// dpal ldan don grub 'jam dbyangs dpal mchog pa// sangs rgyas phun tshags bsod nams dpal ldan dang*// tshul khrims yang na dpal ldan chos skyong mi 'gyur rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs gang thob bsgyur/ lhun grub rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas// kun 'dus bdag nyid dpal ldan bir+wa pas// skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs rjes bzung nas// tshul khrims sum ldan dge ba'i bshes byin rlobs// phyi nang rig pa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams kyi// thos bsam bsgom pa gegs med mthar phyin nas// rgyal ba'i yon tan kun la dbang 'byor zhing*// bstan dang sems can phan pa sgrub par shog /ces rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pa'i srung ba thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni dge slong kun dga' stobs ldan gyis bskul ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub mi zad 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ rdo rje 'chang dang gshin rje'i gshed sogs nas kun dga' bzang po paṇ+ḍi ta/ zhes pa'i bar phrin las char 'bebs nang mchod 'bul skabs ltar brjod/ de nas/ legs 'byung sangs rgyas rin chen dang*/ sa skya lo tsā lha mchog pa// dkon mchog lhun grub sangs rgyas seng*// dkon mchog dpal ldan brang ti pa// kun dga' bkra shis dpal grub mtshan// sher 'byung nam mkha' dpal bzang zhabs// dam chos bsam 'grub bud+dha'i mtshan// bstan lhun dpal ldan chos skyong zhabs/ phrin las rgya mtsho tshul khrims lhun// skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin can rje// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// gshin rje'i gshed sogs yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas pa la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// che mchog rnams kyi yon tan cha// bsams kyin phyag gi phreng ba brtsegs// stong gsum mchod pa'i bye brag rnams// blo yi lag pas blangs nas 'bul// tshe rabs kun gyi sdig ltung rnams// gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang bas bshags// 'phags dang so skye'i dge ba'i rjes// dga' ba'i 'dzum rlabs dkar pos bran// zla bral smra ba'i nyi ma dag /phyogs bcu chos kyi 'od 'gyed cing*// 'khor ba srid du bzhugs gsol ba'i// dge ba byang chub che phyir bsngo// bdag rgyud sdom gsum rnam dag ldan// rim gnyis rtogs pa gong 'phel nas// drod thob spyod pas brtan byas te// dbang phyug brgyad ldan mngon gyur shog /nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun phyogs// phan byed sngags kyis btab tsam nas// tsha ba'i yams la ga pur bzhin// zhi ba'i phrin las 'grub par shog /dpal bskyed las kyi nor bu yi// tshe dang bsod nams stobs 'byor dang*// lung rtogs yon tan ches bdo bas// rgyas pa'i phrin las 'grub par shog /'dod pa'i dmar mdangs mkhur tshos su// 'phos pa'i kā shi mdzes dga' mas// che dgu'i snying gi grogs 'dun pa'i// dbang gi phrin las 'grub par mdzod// dkon mchog gsum dang rnal 'byor sogs// sdang zhing gdug pa'i bsam sbyor mkhan// 'tshe ba'i rgyun bcad dbyings sbyor ba'i// mngon spyod phrin las 'grub par shog

/byang chub bar gyi skye ba'i phreng*// bla ma lhag pa'i lhar bcas pas// rjes bzung mkhas pa'i tshul gsum gyis// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /ces pa rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs ro langs brgyad skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub mi zad 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes pa'i 'di ni dbu mdzad rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas dpal ldan gyi gsung gis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// lam zab bla ma mchod pa'i brgyud rim kha skong ni/ dkon mchog dpal ldan gyi rjes su// shes bya kun gzigs brang ti paṇ+ḍi ta// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa smra mkhas dpal grub pa// rdo rje 'chang chen dpal mchog rgyal mtshan la// gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// gsang chen mdzod 'dzin dam chos bsam 'grub dang*// snyigs dus bstan pa'i snang byed bud+dha'i mtshan// thugs rje'i gter chen bsod nams dpal ldan la// gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// thams cad yang na thams cad gzigs pa tshul khrims lhun grub dang nam mkha' bsam 'grub dpal ldan chos skyong rnams gang rung bsgyur/ gzigs pa bkra shis lhun grub zhabs// gzhan yang zab lam brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gus pa phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa 'di'ang don gnyer byams pa bkra shis kyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༄༅// rgyud gsum bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong 'phro ni/ ༄༅// lhun grub bud+dha'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i rjes su/ shes bzang tshul khrims dang po gsum dang drug pas bud+dha'i mtshan can las gsan/ dpal bzang bsod nams dpal// 'di pas gnyis pa dang gsum pa las gsan/ bsod nams bzang dang 'di pas dang po las gsan/

bkras lhun tshul khrims lhun// nam mkha' bsam 'grub 'di pa gnyis kas gnyis pa dang gsum pa las gsan/ dpal ldan 'di pa gnyis kas gnyis pa dang gsum pa las gsan/ chos skyong zhabs// rin chen 'di pas drug pa las gsan/ mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// skyabs gnas sogs dang sbrel lo// zhes 'di dag gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i 'gros ni mchan bus gsal ba yin mod/ 'dir slob tshogs mang po 'dus pa'i tshogs 'don gyi tshe thus che ba'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na/ bud+dha'i mtshan can rjes bzung bsod nams dpal// gnyis ka las mnos tshul khrims lhun grub zhabs// de sras rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma thams cad la gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa lta bu'am/ yang na/ bud+dha'i mtshan can rjes bzung bsod nams dpal// rdo rje 'chang dngos dpal ldan chos skyong sogs// gzhan yang bka' srol brgyud pa tha dad rgyun// yongs 'dzin bla ma thams cad la gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa lta bu brgyud pa bar ma chad du yod pa zhig dgos kyi/ gdan rabs lta bu thar chags su bsgrigs pas mi chog par sems so// zhes pa'i kha skong gi 'phro 'di'ang lhun grub steng gi dbu mdzad bla ma kun dga' bsod nams pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge bar gyur cig// / ༄༅// dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i gshin rje gshed dmar spros med kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong ni/ ༄༅// rigs gsum rnam 'phrul gsum la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i rjes su// mkhyen rab dbang phyug nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*// gsang rgyud mnga' bdag nam mkha' sangs rgyas dang*// 'gro mgon mtshungs med bsod nams rgya mtsho ste// rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul gsum la gsol ba 'debs// chos smra chen po sangs rgyas dpal bzang dang*// mkhas grub ded dpon sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// rgyal bstan sman mdzad kun dga' chos 'phel te// thugs rje'i gter chen gsum la gsol ba 'debs// kun mkhyen bstan pa'i gsos sman bkra shis bzang*// mgon des rjes bzung tshul khrims rin chen dang*// snyan brgyud 'byung gnas rtsa ba'i bla ma ste// skyabs yul yongs 'dus gsum la gsol ba 'debs// dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma sogs dang sbrel lo// zhes pa'i kha skong 'di'ang rang gis thob pa'i brgyud pa ltar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o//

༄༅// kun rig dbang gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong ni/ ༄༅// thar pa'i lam ston nam mkha' dpal bzang ste// 'dren mchog bla ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa'i rjes su/ mkhas grub chen po nam mkha' sangs rgyas dang*// 'jam dbyangs bla ma nam mkha' dpal bzang pa// bstan pa'i snang byed sangs rgyas phun tshogs te// mkhyen brtse'i gter gyur gsum la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal sras sems dpa' sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin dang*// rdo rje sems dpa' bkra shis lhun grub zhabs// gang des rjes bzung tshul khrims rin chen te// skyabs gnas kun 'dus gsum la gsol ba 'debs// zhes dbang bskur brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha 'gengs 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༄༅// phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong ni/ ༄༅// sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi rjes su/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub bkra shis lhun gyis grub// tshul khrims rin chen la sogs skyabs gnas mchog /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs dang bcom ldan 'das sogs dang sbrel lo// zhes mkhan chen bud+dha lak+ṣ+mīs mdzad pa'i kha skong 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༄༅// tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dbang gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong ni/ ༄༅// lha mchog seng ge bud+dha singha dang*// nam mkha' dpal bzang kun dga' bsod nams dang*// nam mkha' sangs rgyas nam mkha' dpal bzang zhabs// sangs rgyas phun tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs// tshul khrims lhun grub tshul khrims rin chen sogs// dbang bskur gdams pa'i bka' srol legs 'doms pa'i// dngos brgyud dpal ldan bla ma thams cad dang*// yi dam lha tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhes mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa kha 'gengs dang bcas pa 'di'ang dbu mdzad bla ma kun dga' bsod nams pa'i gsung bskul ltar ban+de tshul rin gyis bris pa'o//

༄༅// rje tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong ni/ ༄༅// bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i bstan 'dzin blo gsal dang*// zhes pa'i rjes su/ bka' babs kun gyi mnga' bdag mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// chos gter 'chang ba rje btsun rta ra ba// chos bzhin smra mkhas ngag dbang chos kyi grags// chos kyi spyan yangs dbang phyug rab brtan la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// mkha' spyod thabs mchog kun dga' bsod nams dpal// mkha' mnyam 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// mkha' spyod grub pa bsod nams mtha' yas la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// rgyud don 'chad mkhas bsod nams dbang phyug zhabs// rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag bstan pa rab rgyas dang*// rgyud don legs gzigs bsod nams chos 'phel la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// bstan 'dzin yongs kyi ded dpon sangs rgyas bstan// bstan pa'i snang byed sangs rgyas dpal bzang zhabs// bstan don lhur byed rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// dal 'byor gru chen sogs dang sbrel lo// zhes nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs khrid bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༄༅// dmar khrid brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i kha skong ni/ ༄༅// kun dga'i mtshan can zhes pa'i rjes su/ chos kyi rgyal po blo gsal rgya mtsho dang*// chos mig yangs pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug zhabs// chos mdzod 'dzin pa dbang phyug rab brtan la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// legs bshad 'byung gnas ngag dbang chos kyi grags// legs par gdams pa yongs 'dzin rgyal rtse ba// legs pa'i lam ston khams ston bud+dha'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'phags pa'i sgyu 'phrul sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// 'phags lam 'doms pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang*// 'phags chen spyod mdzad sangs rgyas dpal bzang la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// skyabs gsum 'dus pa rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// skyabs gcig thugs rje'i gter sogs yi dam lha// skyabs mchog bstan pa skyong ba'i tshogs bcas la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs dang sbrel/

zhes pa 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ// ༄༅// sgrol ma dkar mo'i tshe khrid kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rje tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud pa'i kha skong ni// ༄༅// thogs gnas pa dang chos kyi dbang phyug zhabs// zhes pa'i rjes su/ byang chub bzang po bkra shis rnam rgyal la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// bsod nams lha dbang dpal ldan rgyal mtshan zhabs// rje btsun phrin las pa dang tshar chen rje// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rab brtan la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// dpal ldan don grub dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// sangs rgyas phun tshogs kun dga' bstan 'dzin zhabs// tshul khrims rin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// rgyal ba'i yum mchog sogs dang sbrel lo// zhes pa'i kha skong 'di'ang mkhas btsun nam mkha' brtan pa'i ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༄༅// 'jam dpal khro chu sman sdong gi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs// ༄༅// rdo rje 'chang dang 'jam dpal rigs lnga po// 'jam dpal bshes gnyen 'chi med pad+ma 'byung*// bal po dbyig 'dzin sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs// zhang khrom mthu bo che la gsol ba 'debs// dar ma dbang phyug shākya rdo rje dang*// gsang sngags 'dzin pa a grags a dbang mtshan// mi bskyod rdo rje gnyan sras dam pa'i zhabs// rig 'dzin ku mā ra la gsol ba 'debs// mkhas mchog dri med 'od gsal rang grol che// rdo rje rig 'dzin bde chen rang sar grol// sangs rgyas bkra shis rje btsun kun dga' dpal// rin chen rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// spyan tshab mgon zla chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa// bkra shis stobs rgyal karma don yod zhabs// karma chags med ngag gi rdo rje che// khyung grags rdo rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// mkhas btsun bsod nams lhun grub bka' drin can// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// yi dam khro chu dug sdong lha yi tshogs// gter skyong srung mar bcas la gsol ba 'debs// khyed rnams mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag cag 'khor bcas pha rol ngan sems kyis// byad gtad 'khrul 'khor gnod pa las rgyal te// sgo gsum mi phyed rdo rje 'grub par shog

/ces pa'ang don gnyer gyi ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༄༅// 'dzam gling thub pa'i rgyal tshab chen po rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa snyan ngag chu gter bskyod pa'i rlabs phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta bcu gnyis pa skye 'gror prāstā ra bzhi stong go drug pa'i nang gsel chig stong sum brgya

1381 gya gcig pa nas rnyed pa dbang po'i rgyud ces bya bas spras pa'o// ༄// shrīkaṇ+ṭhalekhar+ṣabhatsapradzāpatirnārāyaṇaḥprabhṛtaparbatiramaḥmūr+dhāgrapādastalaban+dhudzīwakas+sar+b+badzñashaud+dhaudanishāraṇārtsatsitaḥ/ ༄༅// yan lag gcig gzugs can las drangs pa'i bsngags pa/ skye dgu'i bdag po dpal mgrin legs bris gtso// sred med bu dang ri sras dga' byed sogs// thor tshugs rtse na zhabs mthil rtsa lag 'tsho// skyabs su mchod pa kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras// mkha' gzugs can las yan lag gcig pa/ dang mnyam nyid song ba shes bya'i mtha'// 'jal byed mkhyen rab 'dom pa yangs ldan de// khyod la nges par rdzogs zhes lhag pa'i lhas// mchog tu bsngags pa legs byin sa skya pa// phyogs rgya che ba'i rgyan las bsam pa rgya che/ bcu'i lus med thul mchog thams cad kyi// yon tan lhun gyis grub kyang skal mnyam skur// sprul nas mkhas tshul skyong ba kun dga' bzang*// rnam gsum bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gtsug tu mchod// thub dbang gzugs can las yan lag gnyis pa/ zhal gyi mchu sgros ut+pal 'dab// 'dzum par dmul ba'i theg gsum chos sgo nas// mkha' dus yan lag rab rdzogs bh+ra ma ra'i// rgyud las 'phos pa'i nyams 'gyur snyan dngags glus// 'byung yon tan gyi rang bzhin brjod pa/ 'gyur ba yi lugs mchog yongs bzung nas// mkhas dbang kun dga'i dpal bskyed tshul gsum gyis// legs par 'doms pa'i blo dang smra ba'i sgo// 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i mdzub rtsis yangs par phye// rkang pa phyi ma zung gi mgor yod pa chod pa'i zung ldan/ de mthus ston pa nged dang dgongs gcig nyid// 'chos skyob rgyud nas 'phos pa'i lung rtogs chos// srid pa'i sgrib gsum mthar byed mi shigs srog /srid par ring 'tsho'i sman gyi bla mar byed// shes byed kyi rgyu las nang shes byed/

de mthar rnam 'dren 'od mtha' yas pa yi// yon tan bkod pa byis blo'i yul min pa'i// zhing der thogs pa med par bzhud de der// legs gsungs 'dzin pa'i rgyal por 'phrin gyis bstan// rigs brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed/ gang mtshan dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa yi ge'i gdangs// thos don dman pa'i skye sgo 'gog bzod pa// thub pa'i rgyal tshab kun dga' bzang po zhes// ris bral mkhas pa'i thos pa 'dzin par 'jebs// tshul khrims don gzhan bkod pa las khyad par la gnas pa/ phung pos brgyan pa gang gi sku// lhan skyes gsung gis srid pa'i gdung ba dbrog /ma la yar skyes nags las 'phos pa'i rdzis// don mthun snying la bde ba ster min nam// dal 'bab nang gi rgyu cung zad dang bcas pas 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo nyid ston pa srid pa can/ rgyun gyis ma bkrus skyon bral gtsang*// rgyan gyis bklubs min blo ldan yid dbang 'phrog /rig byed 'byin pos ma bris dge mtshan dang*// dpe byad bzang po'i gzi byin lham mer 'bar// bcu phrag mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgras zin pa'i dpe/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs srid do 'tshal// 'dren byed skyon bcus rnam dben rgyan gsum dang*// dpyad gsum lam yangs 'dzad pa med 'jo bas// gnyis med gsung gi rjes su rkang pa bkod// theg 'gog pa las rgyus 'gog pa/ gsum chos kyi dga' ston ris bral du// 'gyed pa'i ngo mtshar tshul la mi bsngags te// bstan par mkhas tshul gsum gyis sman 'dogs par// ston mchog sprul pa khyod kyi las yin phyir// skyes sbyangs shes rab dbang pos dpyad dpa' ba phun sum tshogs pa'i zol bstod/ pa'i mdun// grub mtha'i khyad par phra zhib rtogs dka'i mtshang*// cig car brtol na ji snyed shes bya'i yul// ches brling min pa'i gtam 'dis chos la gnod// dpe'i rgyan las bsngags pa'i dpe/

kun phan dkyil 'khor rtag tu gzhan don rgyu// nor 'dzin dus kyi dga' ston 'gro la 'gyed// de mtshungs khyod thugs brtse dang byang sems kyis// gzhan dbang gyur la bdag don khom ma mchis// tha dad sems rab brtag gi dpe/ can re ba 'gengs khyod kyi// ci 'dod re skong mtshungs zla 'os snyam du// dpag bsam rgyags pa mi 'tshal gsol btab 'phral// 'dod pa'i dpal ster rgyal ba kun kyang 'gran// mchog gi nges par bstan pa/ char ldan dus kyis sdong bu lo 'dab dang*// me tog 'bras bu'i dus ston cang 'jo bas// mkhyen brtse nus ster khyed kyis mi bslu bar// dus su sems can phan pa yol med mtshon// rgyal rnams dgyes sems ldan rab brtag 'dzum dmul ba'i phrin las 'od// dkar pos phyogs kyi tha grur khyab pas bdag /bsti gnas nges par phrogs zhes chu srin gyi// rgyal mtshan stong pa'i brdzu la zhugs kyis dogs// de dpa' ba phun sum tshogs pa'i zol bstod/ bzhin gshegs pa rer yang rgyal ba'i sras// dgra bcom grangs med 'khor bcas rgyal kun gyi// zhing gi yon tan bkod pa khyod gcig skur// ma tshang med 'dis kun rdzob bden par gnod// gus bya ba brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed/ pas phyag 'tshal sprul pa'i lus mang gis// phyogs re'i che ba snying la rnam bkod pas// mtsho ldan dgyes pa'i tshig gi phreng bstar te// ye shes gzigs pa'i 'bab stegs bgyid phyir du// bdag gzhan lus dang longs spyod dus gsum gyi// legs byas chu yi gter dang 'od srungs byin// ri gling nyi zla'i sgron ma bye ba brgya'i// stong gsum 'jig rten sprul pa'i maṇ+ḍal dbul// ngag don las bzhin sgra gcig pa/ skye ba lu gu rgyud kyi rang bzhin bcas// dkar min kha na ma tho srid do cog /gnyen po stobs bzhis shel la bsgos pa'i tshon// chu bos bkrus bzhin dag pa'i mthol tshangs bgyi//

mtha' dag gi gzugs can/ 'khor 'das legs byas sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan tshal// phrag dog gnyis 'thung khengs pas ma dkrums par// byang chub spyod pa'i ge sar 'bum dgod par// yi rang nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od kyis phye// rtsub mos 'gog pa/ blang dor 'khrul par 'phyan pa'i gdul bya rnams// gyi nar bskyungs kyang kho bor mi rung med// 'on te gdod ma'i thugs bskyed smon pa'i lam// 'phrin yig thugs la bkrag tshe 'gyod mi 'tshal// mi rtog ting 'bad pas 'gog pa/ 'dzin sgo mang 'byed 'gyur ba'i// myang 'das dbyings kyi bsngags pa smreng sems kyang*// mgon med 'gro ba'i don phyir bskal pa brgyar// 'khor bar brtan bzhugs legs pa'i tshig 'di thal// tshul mtha' dag gzugs can/ 'dir 'bad pa'i lhas bskos chu bzhi'i rgyun// byang chub spyad pa'i rgya mtshor nyer sim nas// ris bral skye bo'i bsam dgu rdzogs pa'i dpal// yon tan nor bu'i 'byung gnas che phyir bsngo// dad gsum ldan pa yon tan gyi rang bzhin brjod pa/ gang dag gsol btab par// rdul bral ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlabs kyis// la gor 'jug pa rnam 'dren rang gi sngon// thugs bskyed smon lam dag pa'i bden mthur khums// kun phan srid pa min pa'i dpe rgyan/ spros pa'i dug dang snang gter gyis// bskyed pa'i mun ltar sa skya'i rje btsun gyi// zhal las sangs rgyas dgongs par 'gal ba'i gtam// 'byung min bstan pa'i bshad sgrub dar bar mdzod// de tshul 'doms pa'i rgyal po ting nge 'dzin gyi rab brtag e waṃ pa'i// phrin las yangs pa'i pha rol mthong 'dod pas// nyi zla'i sgron bteg kun gsal rang gi las// mtha' med sprul snyam nyid du rgyas par mdzod// the tshom phul byung*/ ngur smrig tshon gyis phyogs bcu'i bzhin bkab pa// bshad sgrub lhur len 'dus pa'i khur che'am// thun mtshams 'od kyis gnam sa'i mdangs bsgyur ba// dpyod ldan blo yang som nyir chud par mdzod//

ldan pa'i gzugs can/ mgon khyod rnam thar sprin sngon bzhad sgra yi// rjes su slob par 'dun pa'i mig gtod pa// bdag sogs gdul bya'i sems rgyud mdangs mtha' can// rnam grol 'bras bu'i mngal khur 'dzin par mdzod// chos dang sems yan lag gcig pa'i gzugs can/ can phan 'gyur mi 'gog mod// gzhan du ngan 'gro'i lam gsum 'phyan pa'i sgo// 'gog byed thugs rje'i skyabs sbyin myur brkyangs nas// dal brgyad 'byor bcu rdzogs pa'i rten la sbyor// thams cad ngag don gyi dpe las bzhin sgra gcig pa/ mkhyen rgyu gnas lnga rig pa'i gzhung*// thos dang sbyangs pas rnam par grol ba'i blo// mtshar sdug rkang rtses bsnun pa'i mya ngan med// 'dab ma stong gis 'dzum bzhin mdzes par mdzod// gang yan lag gnyis pa'i gzugs can/ gi byin rlabs sgeg mo'i 'gram chang gis// srid zhi'i dge legs ba ku la yi tshal// kun nas 'dzum dkar bsu ba dkon mchog gsum// 'bral med byang chub bar gyi skyabs su stsol// bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ khams gsum 'khor ba kun tu sdug bsngal dang*// de rgyu kun 'byung nyen pas skyo ba'i yid// gnang bkag bslab pa nye bar klog pa'i bka'// bag yod tshul khrims phung pos brgyan par mdzod// bdag nyid zhi bde lhur bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ len dman pa'i blo// rgyang bskyungs gzhan la phan pa'i snying stobs kyis// zab dang rgya che'i spyod pa rmad byung gis// thams cad mkhyen pa'i gdung 'tshob 'gyur bar mdzod// mtha' dag gzugs can/ sgrib gnyis lha min gsus par bcil ba'i rgyus// gsang rgyud chu klung yongs btung ma har+ṣi sa// smin grol thabs kyi bdud rtsi 'bum skyugs pas// skal bzang sku bzhi'i srog 'tsho mchog tu mdzod// rnam rkang pa bzhi ga'i thog mar yod pa chod pa'i zung ldan/

dag bden gnyis zung 'jug tshong zong gis// rnam mang yon tan rten gyur rab dga' sogs// rnam mang skye dgu'i don du legs bsgrubs nas// rnam 'phrul bye bas gzhan don byed par shog /dge legs shis pa'i mtha' dag gzugs can/ gdugs dkar rigs drug gi /las nyon gdung ba bsil phyir 'khor ba'i khongs// phan bde'i grib mar ngal gso dge ba bcu'i// ro bdar rtsen pa'i ga zha 'byin gyur cig / phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu/ brjod yul yon tan cal sgrogs rjes 'brang min// rjod byed snyan dngags kha gsags gzhan 'drid min// brjod don snying po khe grags bsgrub phyir min// gang phyir snyan dngags byed la bdag cag spro// rgyal gzhi gcig gis byed pa 'gal ba/ bstan dri med rtag tu rgyas gyur pa'i// bkra shis dam pas chos min phyogs rnams nyams// dam pa'i chos smra rnams kyi bshad sgrub dbyangs// snyan dgu srid pa'i khongs 'dir gnas gyur cig /ces 'dzam gling thub pa'i rgyal tshab chen po rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa snyan dngags chu gter bskyod pa'i rlabs phreng zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i legs bshad kyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i gnam lor lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang po'i phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa dge legs rab tu 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// skyabs mchog bla ma rnams la bstod pa mtshan spel ut+pal phreng ba bzhugs// ༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ mkha' mnyam zhing gi rdzogs sangaṃs rgyasaṃ kun gyi// ye shes snang ba gcig gyur 'jam pa'i dpal// ngur smrig mchog 'chang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar// phuṃn tshoṃgs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// nor ldan ma bzhin bsoṃd namaṃs tshogs rgya che// rin chen 'byung gnas ji bzhin yon tan gter// dus kyi rlabs bzhin phrin las mi yol bas// nyer mdzes dpaṃl ldaṃn bla ma la phyag 'tshal// thams cad mkhyen pa sras bcas bgrod gcig lam// nges legs lam kun mgrin pa baṃkra shiṃs dung*// dge mtshan lhuṃn gruṃb g.yas su 'khyil ba las// mi zad 'dod pa 'jo ba la phyag 'tshal// bskal pa bzaṃng poṃ'i lus med thul gyi mchog

/bu ram shing pa'i gsung mdzod yongs bzung nas// bshad sgrub zung gi rgyaṃl mtshaṃn legs slong ba// theg gsum smra ba'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// srid zhi'i bkraṃ shiṃs dpal kun 'byung ba'i gzhi// mi bslu nges pa'i skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum// 'dus pa'i bdag nyid dpaṃl ldaṃn chos kyi rje// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal// kun mkhyen yongs kyi phrin las dge ba'i bshes// rnam par rtsen pas dpaṃl ldaṃn stobs bcu pa'i// lung dang rtogs pa'i choṃs tshul skyongaṃ ba po// skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid la phyag 'tshal// sangaṃs rgyaṃs gsung rab mtha' drug tshul bzhi sogs// ji bzhin 'chad la 'jigs bral ngag gi dpaṃl// 'jam dpal gzhon nus byin pa mkhas pa'i mchog /bskal bzaṃng bstan pa'i sgron ma la phyag 'tshal// sngon sbyangs sna tshogs las kyis legs brdar ba'i// sangaṃs rgyaṃs yeṃ sheṃs mi zad 'od kyi gter// yongs bzung shes bya'i mkha' la legs rgyu bas// legs bshad 'dab stong bzhad pa la phyag 'tshal// blo ldan kunaṃ du dgaṃ' ba bskyed nus pa'i// rnam dkar mkhas pa'i phrin las dpag yas kyis// dam pa'i chos tshul kun tu 'pheṃl byed pa// smra mchog chos kyi nyi ma la phyag 'tshal// mkhyeṃn raṃb byamaṃs paṃ chen po'i mkha' dbyings las// ngaṃg gi dbaṃng phyug zlos gar snang ba'i bdag /mkhas pa'i phrin las lhuṃn gruṃb 'od stong gis// bstan pa'i chu skyes bzhad pa la phyag 'tshal// rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyeṃn brtseṃ sgyu ma'i 'phrul// ngaṃg dbaṃng gzhon nus byin brlabs dge ba'i bshes// rgyal bstan srog zung raṃb tu brtaṃn byed pa'i// bshad sgrub dga' ston 'gyed pa la phyag 'tshal// bskal par bsags pa'i bsoṃd naṃms tshogs mang gis// mngon par bskrun pa'i gsang gsum yon tan mdzod// don gnyis lhuṃn gyis gruṃb pa'i phrin las rgyun// legs par skyong ba'i bshes gnyen la phyag 'tshal// dus gsum sangaṃs rgyus kun gyi yon tan tshogs// yongs bzung mchog gi slob dpon rnam rol gyis// lung rtogs bstaṃn paṃ phyogs bral rgyas mdzad pa// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dam pa la phyag 'tshal// mkhas par 'os pa'i mdzad pa bgrang yas kyis// doṃn kun gruṃb bstan smra ba sa skya pa'i// lugs mchog phyogs las rgyal ba'i rgyaṃl mtshaṃn gang*// brtan byed dge ba'i bshes gnyen la phyag 'tshal// bsngags 'os bla na med par dkoṃn mchoṃg gsum// gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs rdo rje 'dzin// yid srubs las rgyaṃl sdom brtson dge mtshaṃn can// chos tshul 'doms pa'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// rnam dag bsoṃd namaṃs chu ba bskyed bsrings rtser// kun mkhyen nyi ma'i 'od brgyas rab phye ba'i// theg gsum chos kyi sbrang rtsi'i rgyalaṃ mtshanaṃ can// lugs mchog dga' tshal mdzes pa la phyag 'tshal// yid bzhin noṃr buṃ lta bu'i yon tan gyis// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i skal ba dang 'tsham par// mngon par mtho dang nges legs bzaṃng poṃ'i lam// mi zad mgrin las 'jo ba la phyag 'tshal// kuṃn dgaṃ'i 'byung gnas brtse chen lugs mchog gi

/rjes su sgrub pa'i bzang spyod rmad byung gis// doṃn kun gruṃb pa'i chos mchog snang byed pa'i// legs mdzad rnam par rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal// tshogs zung kuṃn dga'iṃ chu gter che las thon// dpaṃl gyi 'byung gnas bla ma rin po che// skal bzaṃng skye bo smin cing grol byed pa'i// nges legs lam du 'god pa la phyag 'tshal// srid zhir bkraṃ shiṃs sgrub pa'i sgra dbyangs can// chos kyi rgyal po sa skya pa yi bstan// yaraṃ ngo'i zla ba'i ngo mtshar ji bzhin du// phyogs kun 'pheṃl bar mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal// lung rigs rtsibs stong bkraṃ shiṃs 'khor lo yis// shes bya'i nor 'dzin ma lus dbang bsgyur zhing*// 'phags nor rin chen bdun gyis mngon gtams pa// smra ba'i dbaṃng phyuṃg grub pa la phyag 'tshal// sbyin bzhi la sogs rnam dkar bsod nams dang*// bsaṃm gtaṃn shes rab dri med yeṃ sheṃs tshogs// zung 'jug 'bras bu'i theg pa la brten nas// rang gzhan phan bder sbyor ba la phyag 'tshal// sems dpa' kuṃn tu bzang bzhin rmad byung gi /snying rje'i spyod pas mkhas pa dgaṃ' byed pa'i// tsheṃ rabs phreng ba'i mar gyur sems can don// grub pa'i snying stobs brtanaṃ pa la phyag 'tshal// theg gsum bstanaṃ paṃ dam pa'i thos pas phyug /rnam gsum ngur smrig rgyaṃl mtshaṃn 'dzin tshul gyis// lam gsum 'gro la sman pa'i phrin las can// skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid la phyag 'tshal// srid zhi'i dpal kun 'byung gnas dkoṃn mchoṃg gsum// gcig tu gyur pa'i rang bzhin dge ba'i bshes// mkhas btsun bzangaṃ poṃr grub pa'i yon tan gyis// blo gsal yongs kyi bsngags 'os la phyag 'tshal// gzhung lugs thos pa rgya mtsho'i klong yangs su// zab lam rim pa zung gi bsaṃm gtaṃn gyis// yon tan riṃn cheṃn gter la dbang 'byor ba// 'dren mchog gdengs can dbang po la phyag 'tshal// ring nas thos bsam bsgom pas sbyangs pa'i thugs// sgrib bral naṃm mkhaṃ'i mkhur tshos ngos yangs su// thugs rje'i zla ba rab rgyas bstan pa'i dpaṃl// skal bzaṃng 'gro ba'i 'dren pa la phyag 'tshal// rgyal bstaṃn dri med 'dziṃn pa'i mchog rnams las// dbang rgyud gdams pa thos pa'i mthar son nas// rtse gcig bsgom pas ye shes snang ba che// lhunaṃ gruṃb sku bzhi'i bdag nyid la phyag 'tshal// rgyal sras thu bo 'jaṃm dbyaṃngs gzhon nu yis// byin rlabs bdud rtsi 'thungs pas choṃs kun la// 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor lang tsho daṃr bab cing*// legs gsungs 'doms pa'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// ngag gi dbang phyug bla mas rjes su bzung*// tshuṃl khriṃms bslab gzhi thos pa'i nags su skyes// rgyal sras sdom pa'i riṃn cheṃn ljon pa'i phang*// sngags spyod 'bras bus dud pa la phyag 'tshal// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma'i mchog rnams la// bstod pas mgrin par brgyan pa de yi rgyud// srid zhi'i bkraṃ shiṃs 'byung gnas kun tu bzaṃng*// rdo rje 'chang ba chen poṃ mngon gyur shog

/de srid skye bar dal 'byor rten dang ldan// yang dag bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral bar// dgyes pa'i zhal las ji snyed chos kyi tshul// thos dang dpyod pa'i lang tsho bdo bar shog /blo gros dkyil 'khor rnam gsal nyin mor byed// dad dang spro ba'i rlung gi shing rtar brten// shes bya'i mkha' la thogs pa med rgyu zhing*// rnam 'dren bstan pa'i 'dab stong bzhad par shog /ces dpal ldan bla ma bkra shis bzang po pa'i chos gsan yul gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la bstod pa mtshan spel ut+pal phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyi bka' lung gis bskul ngor/ snyom las mkhan ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa 'di yun ring bar du 'gyangs shor ba'i nyes pa sgo gsum bsags pa'i sdig ltung tshogs dang lhan cig dpal ldan bla ma de nyid kyi drung du mthol zhing bshags so// thugs brtse ba chen pos tshe rabs kun du rjes su gzung du gsol// maṅga laṃ// // ༄// bka' drin che ldan bla ma rnams la bstod pa ut+pal phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ dpal ldan stobs bcu mnga' ba yongs kyi rtsal// gcig tu rdzogs pa'i skur sprul bskal pa 'dir// bstan dgra ming gi mthar mdzad bstan pa'i dpal// ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen la phyag 'tshal// lha mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs nyid tshul mthong ngor// mtshams sprin lang tshos sgeg pa'i rnam rol gyis// bde gshegs phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad pa// mkhas mchog sangs rgyas phun tshogs la phyag 'tshal// grangs med skye bar tshogs bsags chu bo'i gter// thugs bskyed smon lam lhun pos bsrubs las skyes// lnga rig 'dab stong tshal bzhad nyin mor byed// kun mkhyen bsod nams bzang po la phyag 'tshal// shes bya kun la dpyod pa'i blo gros rgyas// rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin blang dor ma nor lam// rang gzhan legs sbyor yon tan bye ba'i mdzod// grub dbang bkra shis lhun grub la phyag 'tshal// sngon sbyangs mi dman rin chen rtsig ngos su// dpag yas shes bya'i gzugs brgya bkrag tu che// mkhas dbang ha nu man+tha dga' ba'i dpal// 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims lhun grub la phyag 'tshal// sde snod gsum gyis bstan bya yongs bzung nas// rnam mang 'gro khams 'tsham par legs 'doms pas// mngon mtho nges legs phyogs rab snang byed pa// dpal ldan nam mkha' bsam 'grub la phyag 'tshal// rgyal sras spyod pa'i gdugs dkar g.yo ba'i grib// sdug bsngal tsha bas nyen dgu ngal gso zhing*// phan bde'i zil mngar 'thung la mngon sbyor ba// mgon po dpal ldan chos skyong la phyag 'tshal// gtsug lag rab 'byams 'chad mkhas ngag gi dbang*// nyes pa bag chags bcas spangs dgra bcom che// khams gsum bu ltar brtse ldan sems dpa' che// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas dpal bzang la phyag 'tshal// zur phud lnga ldan lha yis legs phye ba'i// mtha' klas shes bya la 'jug mkhyen pa'i spyan// srid pa mya ngan 'das kyi bar bgrang pa// smra dbang sangs rgyas ye shes la phyag 'tshal// mdo sngags sprin gyi khang bzang yangs pa las// zab rgyas gdams pa'i char zim 'dod pa dgus// skal ba bzang ldan yid kyi nor 'dzin snod// 'gengs mdzad bstan 'dzin lhun grub la phyag 'tshal// mu med zhing gi sangs rgyas gsang ba gsum// dus 'dir rdo rje slob dpon rnam rol gyis// lus can rdo rje 'dzin sar 'khrid byed pa// grub dbang sangs rgyas bstan pa la phyag 'tshal// gsang rgyud gdengs can rtsen pa'i pho brang nas// legs blangs smin grol dbang gi rgyal po yis// bstan 'gro'i mi mthun rgud pa sel brtson pa'i// chos rje kun dga' chos 'phel la phyag 'tshal// dus gsum sangs rgyas yon tan srid pa'i mtshor// mkhas btsun grub pa'i 'dab stong grol ba las// mdo sngags sbrang rtsi'i bcud len 'bum 'gyed pa// khyab bdag kun dga' bstan 'dzin la phyag 'tshal// skyes sbyangs rnam par dpyod pa'i 'dren byed stong*// bcu phrag shes bya'i gzhung la ches rno bas// kun mkhyen bstan la mkhas pa'i las byas pa// 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// rnam mang phrin las yal ga ring brkyangs pa'i// byang chub sems kyi rtsa brtan ljon pa'i shing*// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i skyed tshal mdzes pa'i dpyid// brtse chen bkra shis bzang po la phyag 'tshal// mthu rtsal grub pa'i yon tan yangs pa'i mtha'// gser mngal sprul pa'i 'doms kyis gzhal min na// sgrib bcas blo yi bung bas ci ste rtogs// mkhas btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang la phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gtsug lag gnas la sbyangs byung blos// bstan pa rin chen cha shas byi dor bgyis// mos ldan blo ngor gdan gsum lha yi grong*// bsngags 'os tshul khrims rin chen la phyag 'tshal// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma'i mchog rnams la// bdag cag rtse gcig gus pas gsol btab pas// 'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad du// thugs rjes nyer dgongs byin gyis brlab tu gsol// phun tshogs dge bas bskrun pa'i dal 'byor lus// thob kyang myur du 'jig pa'i tshul shes nas// sdig spong dge ba bsgrub la brtson pa dang*// dge sbyong chos bzhir slob par byin gyis rlobs// rang don zhi bde gyi na'i sems spangs nas// tshe rabs du ma'i drin chen mar gyur 'gro// bde la sbyor zhing sdug bsngal bsal 'dod kyi// byams dang snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs// 'gro rnams srid las gdon phyir thams cad mkhyen// smon 'jug sems mchog bskyed pa'i grur zhugs nas// lta sgom spyod pa'i chu gter che mthar son// rgyal ba'i gdung mchog 'tshob par byin gyis rlobs// chos kun rmi lam gzugs 'drar sems nyid snang*// sems snang sgyu ma'i sngags btab cir yang 'char// shar tshul dpyad na skye 'gag gnas pa bral// brjod bral lta ba rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// sngags spyod dam tshig gnyen po'i rtsa ba brling*// rim gnyis lta ba'i snye ma ci yang smin// phrin las 'dod dgu'i dga' ston rab 'gyed cing*// sku bzhi'i dpag bsam brnyes par byin gyis rlobs// byang chub bar gyi tshe rabs thams cad du// dal 'byor rten ldan dam pas rjes su bzung*// tshul khrims la gnas thos bsam bsgom pa'i las// mthar son don gnyis grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes bka' drin che ldan bla ma rnams la bstod pa ut+pal phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/
